content.value_statement: Data teams need reliable pipelines, clear data models, and repeatable operations. This skill guides architecture, quality checks, orchestration, performance tuning, and DataOps practices.
actual_capabilities: Guides batch and streaming pipeline architecture using Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, and cloud data platforms.
Provides patterns for data modeling, data quality checks, observability, governance, and production reliability.
Includes visible command examples for orchestration, validation, testing, formatting, deployment, and monitoring workflows.
Summarizes performance targets, reliability practices, security controls, and team responsibilities for data systems.
Supplies scaffold Python scripts that parse CLI arguments and return status output for data workflow tasks.
limitations: The included Python scripts are scaffolds and do not process real datasets without extension.
Deployment commands are examples and require review before use in a live environment.
The skill does not connect to databases, cloud services, or streaming systems by itself.
It supports planning and review but does not replace compliance or security approval.

use_cases.title: Design a Data Platform
use_cases.description: Create a scalable architecture for batch, streaming, quality, monitoring, and governance needs.

use_cases.title: Review Pipeline Reliability
use_cases.description: Assess failure handling, retries, observability, deployment flow, and performance targets before production release.

use_cases.title: Standardize DataOps Practices
use_cases.description: Define shared practices for testing, documentation, deployment, monitoring, and team ownership.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Pipeline Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a batch data pipeline for source, transform, quality checks, storage, and monitoring. Keep the plan practical.

prompt_templates.title: Data Model Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this data model for scalability, maintainability, quality rules, and governance gaps. Suggest clear improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Production Readiness Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production readiness review for this pipeline. Cover reliability, observability, security, deployment, rollback, and ownership.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Platform Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a data platform strategy for batch, streaming, orchestration, cataloging, quality, cost control, and incident response.

output_examples.input: Plan a pipeline for daily sales data from files to a warehouse.
output_examples.output: A staged architecture with ingestion, validation, transformation, warehouse loading, quality checks, monitoring, and ownership recommendations.

output_examples.input: Review our pipeline for production readiness.
output_examples.output: A checklist covering retries, alerting, data quality thresholds, deployment safety, access control, rollback plans, and support responsibilities.
A performance review with profiling steps, partitioning options, batching guidance, cache candidates, and monitoring metrics.

best_practices: Provide source systems, volumes, latency targets, freshness needs, and compliance constraints before asking for architecture guidance.
Ask for failure handling, monitoring, ownership, and rollback plans when reviewing production pipelines.
Validate generated recommendations against your data platform standards before implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not run deployment examples against production without review and approval.
Do not treat scaffold scripts as complete validators or optimizers for real datasets.
Do not share secrets, credentials, or regulated data in prompts.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps design and review data pipelines, data models, DataOps practices, and production data engineering workflows.

faq.question: Does it run infrastructure changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and visible command examples. Users must review and run any commands themselves.

faq.question: Are the included scripts production ready?
faq.answer: No. They are scaffolds that parse arguments and return status output. Real processing logic must be added.

faq.question: Can it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide data sources, volumes, SLAs, target platforms, data quality needs, security constraints, and current pain points.

faq.question: Does it replace a security review?
faq.answer: No. Use it for planning and review support, then follow your required security and compliance process.
